SUBJECT: Local Law 58/87 - Story at Grade


REFERENCES: Administrative Code Section 27-292.5(i), Non-Grade
Stories of Small Non-Residential Buildings. This TPPN supercedes
the Instructional Memorandum from George E. Berger, P.E., former
Assistant Commissioner, dated October 23, 1989.

PURPOSE:   To further clarify non-grade stories and redefine a
"story at grade."

EFFECTIVE DATE: Immediately

SPECIFICS: A story at grade shall be an occupiable floor which
has direct access to grade, and is less than or equal to eight
inches above or below the adjoining grade elevation.

The adjoining grade elevation shall be the average elevation of
the final grade adjoining all exterior walls of a building
fronting a street, calculated from grade elevations taken at
intervals of ten feet around the perimeter of the building.

An above-grade story shall be any occupiable floor more than
                                grade and is not a story at


A below-grade story shall be any occupiable floor more than eight
                                         and is not a story at grade.
